Secondary Personas

Additional audience segments including regulatory bodies, compliance teams, and IT decision-makers.

Secondary Personas

Regulatory Auditor

Role: Government or programme administrator auditing subsidy dossiers Primary concern: Verifying compliance and detecting fraud Pain point: Reviewing thousands of dossiers manually with limited time How iverif.io helps: Complete audit trails, standardized validation reports, flagged anomalies

Compliance Director

Role: C-level or VP responsible for regulatory compliance across programmes Primary concern: Risk management and audit readiness Pain point: Lack of visibility into validation accuracy and error trends How iverif.io helps: Real-time dashboards, error trend analysis, compliance reporting

IT Director

Role: Technology decision-maker evaluating integration and security Primary concern: Data security, system reliability, integration complexity Pain point: SaaS solutions that require months of integration work How iverif.io helps: REST API, SAML/SSO, GDPR compliance, 99.9% uptime SLA

Operations Director

Role: Leader managing multiple teams and programmes Primary concern: Efficiency, cost per dossier, team productivity Pain point: Difficulty scaling operations during volume spikes How iverif.io helps: Auto-scaling processing, queue management, productivity metrics

Small Operator (SME)

Role: Owner of a small energy services firm processing 50-200 dossiers/year Primary concern: Cost-effectiveness and ease of use Pain point: Cannot afford dedicated compliance staff How iverif.io helps: Pay-per-dossier pricing, managed onboarding, no IT required
